rootCause: Marked codeRemoveIndent chooses the 1–4 spaces regexp branch before the space-plus-tab branch; removes characters rather than four columns. JavaScript multiline anchors also strip whitespace after U+2028/U+2029 inside code.
fix: Reuse Marked block boundaries and paragraph interruption; strip exactly four leading columns on LF-delimited lines with existing tab-stop helper in both footnote boundary and document lexers.
